items.title: Types of Data: Structured and Unstructured (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Types of Data: Structured and Unstructured' under topic 6.2 (PDF 77, printed 73).

blocks.text: Structured data ek saaf, muqarrar shakal mein hota hai, jaise tables ya spreadsheets. Is mein rows (qataarein) aur columns hote hain jo samajhna asaan hai. Misal: talaba ki mark sheets aur databases. Unstructured data ki koi muqarrar shakal nahi hoti (Figure 6.2). Misal: emails, images, audio aur videos. Unstructured data ka seedha analysis mushkil hai; ise process karne ke liye khaas tools chahiye. Dono qismein aham hain, aur aaj ke systems dono istemal karte hain.

blocks.alt: Do panels, beech mein VS ka nishan. Baen taraf Structured Data: table jis ke columns ID, Name aur Age hain aur rows 1 Basim 16, 2 Umer 12, 3 Anie 15; neeche tick wali list: Tables, Databases, Spreadsheets. Daen taraf Unstructured Data: tasveer, likha hua document, chat ka bulbula aur chhota app icon; neeche list: Text, Images, Audio.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.2: Data ki qismein (kitab ki Figure 6.2 par apna khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Structured data rows aur columns wali saaf table ki shakal mein hai; unstructured data tasveeron, documents aur messages ka mila jula majmua hai.

blocks.caption: Structured aur unstructured data ek nazar mein
rows: Rows aur columns ki muqarrar shakal
Seedha analysis mushkil; khaas tools chahiye

blocks.prompt: Har ek ko structured ya unstructured batayein: class ka hazri register, record kiya hua lecture, fees ki spreadsheet, WhatsApp voice messages.
blocks.explanation: Structured: hazri register aur fees spreadsheet (muqarrar rows aur columns). Unstructured: record kiya hua lecture (video ya audio) aur voice messages (audio).
